main_body: two-story half-timbered and stone building with tiled hip roof
top_band: tiled roof slope from row 0 to row 42 (orange/reddish-brown tiles with highlight ridge at rows 1-3)
evidence: Reading down the center column: rows 0-42 show the foreshortened tiled roof surface (with a bright ridge at rows 1-3 and eave edge at row 42), followed by dark eave shadow at rows 43-47 over the half-timbered upper wall (rows 43-76) and lower stone wall (rows 77-106). Windows and door are recessed.

style.evidence: The candidate is an authentic Beodeul chipset building using the exact same roof tile ramp (6 steps), plaster speckle, timber framing, and cobblestone wall texture as the two Beodeul reference houses on the left.
